Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP for Quantix - internal dry run

Team —

Attaching my first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) / evaluation plan for Quantix ahead of the customer kickoff later this week. The external kickoff is on Thu 16 Apr; I want us to run a 30-min internal dry run tomorrow to align RACI, owners, and the success criteria we'll present.

High-level asks:
- Please review the MAP worksheet (tabbed by milestone) and the stakeholder grid. Focus on: technical owner for the evaluation, who will take the PoC infrastructure tasks, and confirmation of timeline (2-week eval vs. 4-week).
- Suggest any changes inline or add comments in the Drive copy.
- Confirm availability for an internal dry run: Wed 14 Apr 2026 10:00–10:30 PT or 14:00–14:30 PT.

Key unknowns I flagged in the draft:
- Evaluation success criteria need clearer pass/fail (latency targets, throughput batch size, cost per 1k tokens).
- Data access: whether they can share a 10k-row sample now or need a pseudo dataset.

Attachments (stubs):
- QX_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP timeline, milestones, tasks)
- stakeholder_grid_v1.csv (roles + contact info)
- evaluation_criteria_notes.pdf (initial KPIs)

If we can get alignment internally tomorrow, I will send the customer-facing MAP during the kickoff and lock owners.

Thanks —
Rishi
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP for Quantix - internal dry run

Rishi —

Thanks for pulling this together. I read through the MAP and added inline comments on the Drive link (see related_links). A few quick notes here so the dry run is efficient: 

1) RACI adjustments
- Technical owner: Dev should be "Technical SE lead" for the evaluation. He will own infra setup and run the initial perf runs.
- Product owner: Priyom should be listed for product acceptance criteria and UX sign-off for integration points.
- Sales owner: Rishi (overall timeline and customer comms).

2) Success criteria (must be explicit)
- Latency: p95 < 350ms for 512-token requests on their chosen instance type.
- Throughput: sustain 4 concurrent sessions with <500ms median latency.
- Quality: BLEU/ROUGE not the right metric here; instead let's use the customer-defined acceptance set (they provided 50 priority prompts).

3) Timeline
- Strongly suggest making the evaluation window 3 weeks instead of 2: week 1 infra + sample prep, week 2 integration + perf, week 3 acceptance and wrap-up.

4) Evidence & compliance ask for customer kickoff: have the SOC2 summary and our data retention page ready. I can pull the artifacts.

I'll join the 10:00 PT slot. Dev — can you confirm you can own the infra tasks and the test harness?

Monica Patel
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
